messages:
katie: Heads up — three docs PRs are blocked on review and CI preview flaky for the SDK snippets migration. Can someone pick these up?

alex: which PRs? links? :thinking_face:

katie: PRs: #4321 (python SDK snippet update), #4334 (js snippet link fixes), #4338 (migration guide examples). Preview links failing intermittently — sometimes 502 on the render job.

jisoo: I saw the 502 earlier. It looks like the preview job times out when the snippet parsing hits large code blocks.

sam: Confirmed. Reproducer: run `./tools/docs-preview --pr 4334` locally, if it times out increase `DOCS_RENDER_TIMEOUT`.

katie: thanks @sam. I don't want to change timeouts without triage. We need reviewers first so we can at least merge the smaller fixes (#4334) and unblock the migration guide.

ryan: I can review #4334 tonight if someone else picks up the python snippets.

alex: I can take #4321 (python). Quick note: some snippets need `from redwood import InferenceClient` -> `from redwood_inference import Client` rename and a couple of arg name changes.

jisoo: I'm happy to eyeball the migration guide examples (#4338) but need a quick checklist: 1) run local preview, 2) sanity-check generated TOC, 3) ensure code blocks have language tags.

katie: perfect. Can we also assign a temporary docs-rotation owner this week to avoid gaps? Our usual rotation doesn't start until next month.

sam: volunteer to be temp owner for this week. I'll triage PRs and escalate CI flakes. :thumbsup:

katie: amazing, thanks @sam. Sam — can you open a short triage thread in #eng-oncall if the preview job keeps failing? We need a template for flaky preview jobs.

sam: yep. Will do. Also will add a quick runbook: 1) re-run preview job, 2) check logs `kubectl logs docs-renderer-*-job`, 3) fallback: merge small docfixes behind a flag set in frontmatter to avoid heavy render steps.

docs-bot: Preview link for PR #4334: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/4334 — status: failed (502). Re-run: https://ci.redwood.ai/retry/4334

ryan: re-run in progress, ping me if green and I'll review immediately.

alex: note for reviewer: for python snippet changes, run `pytest docs/snippets/test_python_examples.py` locally to catch API mismatches.

katie: ok — plan: Alex -> #4321, Ryan -> #4334 once CI green, Jisoo -> #4338. Sam is temp owner to coordinate CI and merges. I'll update the docs-review-rotation spreadsheet. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
